en.description: Read papers, plan studies, write manuscripts, and prepare research outputs from the evidence you provide.
en.short_description: Read, plan, and write academic research
en.default_prompt: Use $qiongli to help with my research task using the materials I provide.

zh.description: 依据你提供的证据，阅读论文、设计研究、撰写文稿并准备研究成果。
zh.short_description: 阅读论文、设计研究与撰写学术文稿
zh.default_prompt: 使用 $qiongli，根据我提供的材料协助完成当前研究任务。

en.description: Reply in chat without tools, file changes, or research workflow execution when you request reply only.

zh.description: 当你选择“仅回复”时，只在对话中回答，不调用工具、修改文件或执行研究流程。

en.description: Prepare an academic talk: plan the content, design the slides, and choose the output format.

zh.description: 准备学术报告，规划内容、设计幻灯片并选择输出格式。

en.description: Draft or revise a research paragraph, section, or proposal while preserving its evidence and claim limits.

zh.description: 撰写或修改学术段落、章节或研究提案，保留证据依据和主张边界。

en.description: Build a theoretical framework and explain the relationships between research concepts.

zh.description: 构建研究的理论框架，梳理概念之间的关系。

en.description: Build research analysis code from a paper description or a named method.

zh.description: 根据论文中的方法描述或指定的方法，编写研究分析代码。

en.description: Check reporting requirements, research integrity, and writing style before submission.

zh.description: 投稿前检查报告规范、研究诚信和写作风格。

en.description: Prepare assignment briefs, rubrics, and drafts, then check readiness for submission.

zh.description: 准备课程作业说明、评分标准和草稿，并检查提交准备情况。

en.description: Plan a dissertation, organize chapters, address supervisor feedback, and prepare for submission or defense.

zh.description: 规划学位论文、组织章节、处理导师反馈，并准备提交或答辩。

en.description: Prepare research ethics documents, including consent, recruitment, data security, and ethics statements.

zh.description: 准备研究伦理审查材料，包括知情同意、招募说明、数据安全方案和伦理声明。

en.description: Identify research gaps and possible directions for further study.

zh.description: 识别现有研究的空白，提出可进一步探索的研究方向。

en.description: Conduct a systematic literature review within the agreed protocol and report it using PRISMA 2020.

zh.description: 按既定方案开展系统性文献综述，并依据 PRISMA 2020 报告方法与结果。

en.description: Choose a paper type and the stage or section you want to work on.

zh.description: 选择论文类型，以及当前要处理的阶段或部分。

en.description: Work through a research paper from topic selection to journal fit and feedback.

zh.description: 推进研究论文的各个阶段，从选题到期刊匹配和反馈处理。

en.description: Read a paper or excerpt, explain its findings, and create notes linked to the source.

zh.description: 阅读单篇论文或所给片段，解释研究发现并整理可追溯至原文的笔记。

en.description: Write a full paper from existing research materials, linking claims to evidence and checking reporting requirements.

zh.description: 根据已有研究资料撰写完整论文，关联主张与证据，并检查适用的报告要求。

en.description: Proofread an academic manuscript for clear language, consistent terms, and accurate attribution without changing its claims.

zh.description: 校对学术文稿，改善语言表达、统一术语并核对归属表述，保留原有主张。

en.description: Turn reviewer comments into a revision plan, response matrix, and response letter.

zh.description: 将审稿意见整理为修订计划、逐条回复表和回复信。

en.description: Summarize a completed research stage and review which files to keep; you decide what to delete.

zh.description: 整理已完成的研究阶段，并逐项检查文件保留需求；由你决定是否删除文件。

en.description: Plan or assess a study using the research question, available materials, and protocol requirements.

zh.description: 根据研究问题、可用材料和方案要求，制定或评估研究设计。

en.description: Prepare submission checklists, a cover letter, and the required statements.

zh.description: 准备投稿检查清单、投稿信和所需声明。

en.description: Synthesize screened, extracted, and appraised evidence using narrative, qualitative, or meta-analytic methods.

zh.description: 基于已筛选、提取和质量评价的证据，开展叙述综合、定性综合或荟萃分析。
